Home Brick White White Inside Corner Ledger
The inside corner ledger is engineered to fasten onto the shiplap of the 90° inside corner panel. The sloped design of the straight ledger makes it difficult to miter perfectly, making this inside corner ledger an ideal solution if you intend to transition your ledger through a 90° inside corner.
